item: HCR-9 (step 1: tuned lean against tuned high)
question: HCR-8 found two changes that help both profiles (whole-memory rows, the MMR re-cut off) and never measured both together on lean. How far ahead is a tuned high of a tuned lean?
method: HCR-8's set and scoring unchanged (347 held-out questions over three corpora, pooled-judged gold, plain recall() top 10; planning/HCR-8.evidence.2026-11-26.json has the method). One arm added to bench/high_eval.py --phase2: lean with whole-memory rows AND HIPPO_MMR_LAMBDA=1.0. It was run by --phase2 --lean-only (lean's arms alone, no MLX model loaded) on all three corpora on 2026-11-27. corpus-b had gained three memories since HCR-8's pass, so its whole phase-2 pass (the high arms included) was re-run the same day and replaces the 2026-11-26 one here; hippo and corpus-c pair the new lean arm with the high arms of 2026-11-26. repeated_arms is the check that this is sound: every lean arm the two passes share returned the identical top 10 on every question.
corpus_labels: hippo = hippo's own corpus (108 indexed memories); corpus-b and corpus-c are two private project corpora of 113 and 1,070 indexed memories
summary: Tuned lean (bge-small, whole-memory rows, MMR off): 317 of 347 in the top 10 ([0.8793, 0.9388]), MRR 0.7241 [0.6854, 0.7623]. Lean as shipped: 286 ([0.7807, 0.8606]), MRR 0.6679 [0.6239, 0.7111].
Tuned high (Qwen3-Embedding-4B, whole-memory rows, MMR off): 335 of 347 ([0.9405, 0.9801]), MRR 0.7772 [0.7414, 0.8098].

The margin of tuned high over tuned lean, paired over the same questions: +0.0519 [0.0231, 0.0807] in hit rate (23 questions only high found, 5 only lean), +0.0531 [0.0247, 0.081] in MRR. Both intervals exclude zero, so tuned lean does NOT land inside tuned high's interval and the stop the plan asked for did not fire.
All of it is on paraphrased questions: +0.1040 [0.052, 0.1561] there, +0.0000 [0.0, 0.0] on questions that may use the memory's own terms.
Both changes help lean, and they add: MMR off alone 302, whole-memory rows alone 307, both 317. Whole rows on top of MMR off are worth +0.0432 [0.0144, 0.072] to lean.
caveats: Plain recall() top 10 with each profile's shipped floor; nothing here measures abstention, injection volume or the prompt hook. Those are the calibration file's job (planning/HCR-9.calibration.evidence.2026-11-27.json).
One target per question: this set counts what the MMR re-cut costs and cannot count what it is for. planning/HCR-9.mmr.evidence.2026-11-27.json measures that on near-duplicate clusters.
HCR-8's caveats carry over (model-written questions and judgments; a bias toward the head of each file).
note: private corpora and questions: counts and intervals only, no query and no memory name. Intervals are 95%: Wilson for a hit rate, percentile bootstrap (2000 resamples, seed 20261126) for MRR and for every paired difference.
